headline: 仙逆领跑电影，暗潮之下首播
summary: 本周电影《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》热度领跑，新剧《暗潮之下》《Mayday》首播；热播剧《侠探杰克》《末日地堡》与《无职转生》持续吸睛。

industryHighlights.text: 电影《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》领跑本周热作
industryHighlights.en: Xian Ni Theatrical: Battle of Immortal Slaying tops this week's film buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧《Mayday》《魔女嘉莉》《库比蒂诺》《暗潮之下》本周首播
industryHighlights.en: New series Mayday, Carrie, Cupertino and Undercurrent premiere this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《侠探杰克》《母狮》《无职转生》《末日地堡》《Re:从零》持续热播
industryHighlights.en: Jack Reacher, Lioness, Mushoku Tensei, Silo and Re:Zero remain hot.

industryHighlights.text: 《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《幻视任务》《夜曲》等待映待播受关注
industryHighlights.en: Avengers 5, Dune 3, Vision Quest and Nocturne are among upcoming titles drawing attention.

headlineEn: Xian Ni Leads Films; Undercurrent Premieres
summaryEn: This week, film Xian Ni Theatrical: Battle of Immortal Slaying leads buzz, while new series Undercurrent and Mayday premiere; hot shows Jack Reacher, Silo and Mushoku Tensei remain in focus.
